description: Reverse (issue #72): holding reverse drops the bucket over the nozzle and the jet pushes the craft back, up to a jog (about 2.1 m/s; the transom drags 8 times as hard backwards); it brakes a craft moving forward; the bars steer the stern, so the nose turns against them; and letting go lifts the bucket so throttle drives forward again.

steps.name: reverse drops the bucket and runs the jet
the craft backs up at a jog
in reverse, steering right swings the stern right: the nose turns left
reverse brakes to a crawl within 4 s
letting go lifts the bucket, and the throttle drives forward again
